formalScope.map: N(x) = (1 / ‖x‖) • x, followed by a deterministic transition and observation of the normalized state.
formalScope.domain: real inner-product space; the observation codomain can be an arbitrary type
premises: The positive-scale quotient is stated on nonzero x and y, with scaling r > 0.
The finite-horizon boundary evaluates the same deterministic transition and observation after the same normalized state, for any natural-number horizon.
The first-order radial-annihilation statement uses a nonzero state and an infinitesimal multiple of that state.
formalScope.extent: Exact positive-scale factorization, a finite deterministic horizon, and the separately stated local derivative boundary.
formalScope.claim: Equal normalized nonzero vectors lie in the same positive-scale orbit. A deterministic consumer receiving only the exact normalized state agrees on those rescalings.
formalScope.studyBoundary: Upstream direction encoding, additional state inputs, and empirical recurrence require their own evidence.
